resources.string: Keeps Guardian\'s on-device content protection active. Removal requires a full factory reset.
Guardian is a personal accountability tool. Activating device administration prevents casual removal of the on-device content filter.

To provision as Device Owner (after factory reset, before adding a Google account):

adb install app-release.apk
adb shell dpm set-device-owner %1$s/%2$s

Guardian screen scanning: periodically takes a single screenshot and checks it for explicit content with an on-device model, and checks the visible text of the apps on your Fast Scan Apps list (messaging apps and browsers by default) against an on-device word list. Nothing leaves the device. Detections are logged locally (a small thumbnail or a short text excerpt) for review.
